items.title: Jalen Johnson is 9-29 (31%) on twos outside of 4 feet this season.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
Jalen Johnson is 9-29 (31%) on twos outside of 4 feet this season. 

For reference, he shot 42% on those shots last season. 

Johnson is also 5-23 from three.

So, Johnson is 14-52 (26.9%) overall from outside of 4 feet this season.

That won't persist (obviously) but notable.
